movies.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping

info.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
info.tagline: Welcome to the Second Quarter Quell.
info.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen volunteers in her sister's place, commencing on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

info.title: Steps
info.overview: After being blamed for disrupting the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, a misunderstood stepsister accidentally turns her sister into a frog and must team up with Cinderella and an unlikely ally to save the kingdom and rewrite their fairytale ending.

info.title: Breeder
info.overview: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

info.title: The Mosquito Bowl
info.tagline: Trained for glory, called to war.
info.overview: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

info.title: Ghost Soldier
info.overview: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

info.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
info.overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

info.title: The Mongoose
info.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

info.title: Wicker
info.overview: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

info.title: Hexed
info.overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

info.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
info.tagline: There is no third time. Everything ends here.
info.overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

info.title: Ebenezer
info.tagline: Before he was Scrooge, he was…
info.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

info.title: LA BOLA NEGRA
info.overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

info.title: Focker In-Law
info.overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, aims to marry Olivia, a strong-willed former hostage negotiator who appears to be his complete mismatch. To Greg's shock, father-in-law Jack Byrnes takes a liking to Olivia, and her unprecedented rise into his Circle of Trust sparks chaos in the family before Jack's 80th birthday party.

info.title: Wildwood
info.tagline: How far would you go for those you love?
info.overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

info.title: Madden
info.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football's most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

info.title: I Play Rocky
info.overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

info.title: Clayface
info.overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

info.title: The Cat in the Hat
info.tagline: The cat's out of the bag.
info.overview: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

info.title: How to Rob a Bank
info.overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

info.title: Fjord
info.overview: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbet Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbet's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

info.title: A Talent for Murder
info.tagline: The end is where the plotting begins.
info.overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

movies.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH

info.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
info.overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

info.title: Wild Horse Nine
info.tagline: Sometimes you've got to do a terrible thing for the greater good.
info.overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

info.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
info.overview: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

info.title: Kung Fu Soccer
info.tagline: One kick can ignite the world.
info.overview: Dismissed as underdogs before they even step onto the pitch, the Emei Women's Football Team enters the prestigious Supreme Invincible Cup determined to prove everyone wrong. Led by captain Shuangshuang, star striker Yulong, and mentor Xu Feng, the team combines martial arts mastery with football skill in a thrilling quest for victory. Against mounting challenges and impossible odds, they fight to make their mark and chase their championship dream.

info.title: Paper Tiger
info.tagline: All debts are paid in blood.
info.overview: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

info.title: Drummer Boy
info.overview: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

info.title: Possible Love
info.overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

info.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
info.overview: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

info.title: Club Kid
info.overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

info.title: Avengers: Doomsday
info.overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

info.title: Dune: Part Three
info.overview: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

info.title: Violent Night 2
info.overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

info.title: Josephine
info.tagline: Too young to understand. Too old to forget.
info.overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

info.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
info.overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet—surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

info.title: De Gaulle: Liberté
info.original: La Bataille de Gaulle : J'écris ton nom
info.overview: While World War II is raging, General De Gaulle seeks to convince the world that the battle for France not lost. Reality seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

info.title: Behemoth!
info.overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

info.title: Ray Gunn
info.tagline: The taller the skyscrapers, the longer the shadows.
info.overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

info.title: The Debut
info.tagline: There’s a method to the madness.
info.overview: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

movies.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ

info.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
info.tagline: The beginning was nearly the end.
info.overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

info.title: La Gradiva
info.overview: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

info.title: Rose
info.overview: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers’ suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

info.title: The Fox
info.overview: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

info.title: Bunker
info.overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

info.title: Flavia
info.tagline: A little genius goes a long way.
info.overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

info.title: Ink
info.overview: After buying a struggling British tabloid in 1969, mogul Rupert Murdoch and editor Larry Lamb band together a group of misfits and visionaries to reshape the image of the news industry as we know it.

info.title: November 1963
info.tagline: Betrayed by power. Fuelled by revenge.
info.overview: Prior to the election of John F. Kennedy in 1960, his father Joe Kennedy asked for a favor from mob boss Sam Giancana and the Chicago Outfit to ensure a win for the younger Kennedy. However, during the presidency, the national organized crime syndicate came under heavy fire from Attorney General Bobby Kennedy. The mob answered this perceived betrayal with the ultimate revenge: the assassination of the 35th President of the United States on November 22, 1963. The events are depicted through the perspective of Sam Giancana's brother, Pepe, who was present during the critical planning stages, detailing the intricate circumstances and the mob's direct involvement in setting up the assassination.

info.title: Above the Below
info.overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

info.title: The Gallerist
info.overview: Set against the glittering excess of Art Basel Miami, a desperate gallery owner conspires to pass off an accidental corpse as the centerpiece of her debut show.

info.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
info.overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

info.title: Tender Loving Care
info.overview: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

info.title: GROTESQQQUE
info.overview: An alien girl wants to be her planet's ambassador to be able to present herself on Earth. A group of high school students take part in a violent battle royale game called The Queen of Butterflies. A pure-blooded, female vampire lives with her servants in a world where humanity has become extinct.

info.title: A Long Winter
info.overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

info.title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
info.tagline: On tour. On film. This fall.
info.overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

info.title: Killing Castro
info.tagline: They tried to change history. Instead they set it in motion.
info.overview: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

info.title: Clarissa
info.overview: Across a single day in Lagos, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

info.title: Eternal Return
info.overview: In this timeless romance, Cass (Naomi Scott) is resigned to a life without love until she meets Virgil (Kit Harington), a mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming

movies.title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena

info.title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
info.overview: Michaela tries her best to be a good person.

info.title: THIS SYMPHONY MAY CONTAIN HOPE.
info.overview: RAYE brings her acclaimed album THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE. to the big screen in a breathtaking orchestral experience filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall. Joined by 117 musicians, she reimagines the album in a powerful four-act journey through love, loss, faith, joy and the complexities of being human. Blending cinematic grandeur with intimate, heartfelt moments, this extraordinary performance celebrates family, resilience and the healing power of music.
